text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Huh! An outing?
With you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I'm honored!
Please, by all means—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Whoa-whoops? Excuse me, please wait a moment!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Hayakawa speaking.
Yes, understood... If it's regarding that matter――

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I apologize, Trainer...
an urgent matter has come up
that requires my immediate attention.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Um, we could always reschedule for another day—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, !
You're so very kind.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me!
Tazuna Hayakawa shall sprint at full throttle to get this sorted♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Haaah... Sorry to keep you waiting~!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The sun has already set, hasn't it? I'm so sorry……

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: If we head out now, we won't be able to go very far... Hmmm...
As Ms. Tazuna and I racked our brains together—
(……*grumble*)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...Was that you just now, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I feel like even Tazuna-san had something like that……

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh, ahaha!
You're right, I really am starving!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I've thought of a wonderful place to go.
Please come along with me!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Umm... Ah, wonderful! It looks like there's an open spot right now.
Where Ms. Tazuna pointed was a ramen shop radiating a gritty, no-nonsense vibe!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: This is my usual go-to spot, you know.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The ramen is great, but the gyoza that comes with the set is soooo delicious too!
choice_data_list: I'm really looking forward to that……!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Let's eat a ton today!
Since you're with me, Trainer, let's get the upsized set!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...Make sure we stop by the supermarket on the way home to buy some milk later, okay?!

And so, I spent a delicious time
together with Tazuna-san.
